title: Item Components Shooter
description: Compels an item to shoot projectiles, similarly to a bow or crossbow. Must have the minecraft:use_modifiers component in order to function properly.

ammunition.title: Ammunition
ammunition.description:
A list of ammunition entries that define which items can be used as projectiles for this shooter. Each entry specifies the item, whether to search the offhand, inventory, and whether to use in creative mode.

Properties:
• item (string)
• search_inventory (boolean) = false
• use_in_creative (boolean) = false
• use_offhand (boolean) = false

Sample values:
• my_sword_shoot: [{"item":"minecraft:snowball","use_offhand":tru...

defaultSnippets.label: Item Components Ammunition
defaultSnippets.description: Is ammunition for a shooter item.

scale_power_by_draw_duration.title: Scale Power By Draw Duration
scale_power_by_draw_duration.description:
When true, the projectile's launch power increases based on how long the player holds the use button before releasing. Default is false.

Sample values:
• my_sword_shoot: true

max_draw_duration.title: Max Draw Duration
max_draw_duration.description:
The maximum time in seconds that a player can draw the shooter before it automatically fires or reaches maximum power. Default is 0.

Sample values:
• my_sword_shoot: 1

charge_on_draw.title: Charge On Draw
charge_on_draw.description: When true, the shooter begins charging when the player starts drawing, similar to a crossbow. Default is false.

search_inventory.title: Search Inventory
search_inventory.description: Can search inventory? Default is set to false.

use_in_creative.title: Use In Creative
use_in_creative.description: Can use in creative mode? Default is set to false.

use_offhand.title: Use Offhand
use_offhand.description: Can use off-hand? Default is set to false.
